title: Canonical unit and compositor for inverse coefficient restriction
statement: For ring-sheaf isomorphisms a:R≅S and b:S≅T, identity maps on underlying module sections give natural identity and composition isomorphisms for inverse restriction, and likewise on cochain complexes. Localizing those comparisons gives natural identity and composition isomorphisms for the canonical exact derived restrictions. On Q(P), the identity is fac_id(P) followed by Q(chainId(P)), and the compositor followed by fac_ab(P) is D(T_b)(fac_a(P)) followed by fac_b(Ch(T_a)P) and Q(chainComp(P)). Both chain comparisons fix every section in every degree. Dependencies: [lem-sfb-ring-isomorphism-tensor-transport], [lem-pur-exact-restriction-composition].

theorem derivedComp_fac {R S T : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{r}} (a : R ≅ S) (b : S ≅ T)
    (P : CochainComplex (scalarModules J R) ℤ) :
    (derivedComp a b).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        (scalarRestriction (a ≪≫ b).inv).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P =
      (scalarRestriction b.inv).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((scalarRestriction a.inv).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ≫
        (scalarRestriction b.inv).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
          (((scalarRestriction a.inv).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((chainComp a b).hom.app P)
